remarks: Welcome to 14 D Cross Highway, a hidden gem nestled in the charming enclave of Westport Village, one of Westport's best-kept secrets. This home offers a unique blend of style and sophistication, perfect for those seeking a modern and elegant lifestyle. This exquisite 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence spans 1,200 square feet and is truly turnkey. Step inside to discover a beautifully updated kitchen with Carrara marble counters all complete with modern appliances. The open-concept living area is enhanced by vaulted ceilings and a cozy gas fireplace, creating an inviting atmosphere for relaxation and entertainment.  The home's character and charm are further accentuated by its thoughtful amenities gas heat and central air for year-round comfort. Conveniently located close to town yet secluded at the end of the private drive. This is truly the ideal oasis.
